analysis.summary: Fonebox Retail Limited reported an 11% year-on-year growth in PAT and a 17% increase in revenue for H1 FY 2024-25. Management highlighted ongoing retail expansion in Gujarat and Maharashtra, focusing on new store additions under FOCO and COCO models. The company targets a revenue of over 400 crore and a PAT of around 4 crore for the full financial year, with expectations to scale revenue to around 700 crore with at least 8 crore PAT by 2026. Fonebox Retail Limited reported its investor presentation for the half year ended September 30, 2024, highlighting operational store counts, financial performance, and software implementations. Management noted that the Indian smartphone retail market was valued at approximately $45 billion in 2024 and projected a CAGR of 8-10% from 2024 to 2029.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a Share Subscription and Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% equity shareholding in NWOM Retailers Private Limited for a total consideration of ₹25.74 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequent to the financial year ended March 31, 2026, and prior to the approval of the Board’s Report for FY 2025-26 by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on August 19, 2026, the Company entered into a definitive Share Subscription and Purchase Agreement (“SSPA”) dated May 22, 2026, for the acquisition of 100% equity shareholding in NWOM Retailers Private Limited.
